shots.text: The Pale Vesper once walked the dead to their rest. Now she sang them awake. Before the end, she sang something else.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Pale Vesper falling among the roots, her ghost-choir scattering like moths.

shots.text: The Marshal sent us to the Rift. The Marshal let us in. He is so... sorry.
shots.speaker: pale_vesper
shots.art_note: Close on the Vesper's face, the grey light leaving her eyes; for a moment she looks like herself.

shots.text: In the root-halls of Elderhollow we found the archer who had held them alone for nine days. Her bow had grown leaves.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Sylvaine Thornwhisper standing amid a ring of fallen hollow things, a pale leafing longbow in her hands, moss cloak. She lowers the bow.

shots.text: Nine days. I counted every arrow. Show me where the next ones go.
shots.speaker: sylvaine
shots.art_note: Sylvaine at the edge of a tower platform, arrow on the string. Joins as a hero.
